description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company as one of its first engineers, owning the development of speech and audio models from research through production. You will help establish the technical direction and build models that support real-time voice workloads.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Pre-train, post-train, and fine-tune text-to-speech, speech recognition, speech-to-speech models, and specialty classifiers.

 - Turn research ideas into production models for enterprise use cases.

 - Build data, training, and evaluation infrastructure from the ground up.

 - Collaborate with the inference team to optimize models for speed and cost.

 - Help recruit and shape the engineering team as it grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Research background in speech or audio, with published work in the field.

 - A PhD or equivalent academic depth, such as a master's degree with substantial research projects.

 - Full-time industry experience developing speech or audio models after completing your degree.

 - Experience building pre-training or post-training pipelines and machine learning data, training, or evaluation infrastructure.

 - Experience shipping production machine learning models and working across the stack from research to deployment.

 - Ability to fine-tune models for specific use cases and optimize latency and cost in production.

 - Strong technical judgment and comfort working as a generalist in a lean, early-stage environment.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 annually, depending on experience. Equity: 0.5% to 1.5%. Visa sponsorship is available depending on visa type, including J-1 and O-1.


LOCATION

Fully remote. Candidates may be based in Canada, Brazil, Europe, or the United States.
